# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release of Prompt King is actively supported for security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| v0.2.0  | :white_check_mark: |
| &lt; v0.2.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please do not open a public issue. Instead, report it directly to the project author/maintainer by emailing the address listed in the repository's git commits.

We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report within 48 hours and work with you to coordinate a security release.
